opentube.name: opentube
opentube.docstring: Access YouTube Public Data without YouTubeAPI.

id.docstring:
Returns the unique id of the channel.

Returns:
    str: The unique id of the channel.

name.docstring:
Returns the name of the channel.

Returns:
    str: The name of the channel.

description.docstring:
Returns the description of the channel.

Returns:
    str: The description of the channel.

subscribers.docstring:
Returns the subscriber count of the channel.

Returns:
    str: The subscriber count of the channel.

views.docstring:
Returns the total number of views the channel got across all videos.

Returns:
    str: The total number of views the channel got across all videos.

country.docstring:
Returns the country of the channel if available.

Returns:
    str | None: The country of the channel if available.

url.docstring:
Returns the url of the channel.

Returns:
    str: The url of the channel.

avatars.docstring:
Returns the avatars of the channel in different resolutions.

Returns:
    List[Dict[str, Any]]: The avatars of the channel.

banners.docstring:
Returns the banners of the channel in different resolutions.

Returns:
    List[Dict[str, Any]]: The banners of the channel.

rss_url.docstring:
Returns the rss url of the channel.

Returns:
    str: The rss url of the channel.

video_count.docstring:
Returns the total number of videos uploaded in the channel.

Returns:
    int: The total number of videos uploaded in the channel.

custom_url.docstring:
Returns the user created custom url of the channel.

Returns:
    str: The user created custom url of the channel.

creation_date.docstring:
Returns the date of creation of the channel.

Returns:
    str: The date of creation of the channel.

socials.docstring:
Returns the socials of the channel.

Returns:
    List[str]: The socials of the channel.

keywords.docstring:
Returns the keywords of the channel.

Returns:
    List[str]: The keywords of the channel.

family_safe.docstring:
Returns whether the channel is marked as family safe.

Returns:
    bool: True if the channel is marked as family safe, False otherwise.

available_country_codes.docstring:
Returns the list of country codes where the channel is available.

Returns:
    List[str]: The list of country codes where the channel is available

verified.docstring:
Returns whether the channel is verified by YouTube.

Returns:
    bool: True if the channel is verified, False otherwise

live.docstring:
Returns whether the channel is currently livestreaming.

Returns:
    bool: True if the channel is currently livestreaming, False otherwise.

metadata.docstring:
Returns channel metadata in a python dictionary format.

Returns:
    Dict: Channel metadata containing the keys like id, name, subscribers, views, country, custom_url, avatar, banner, url, description, socials etc.

streaming_now.docstring:
Fetches the ids of all ongoing livestreams.

Returns:
    List[str] | None: The ids of all ongoing streams or None.

old_streams.docstring:
Fetches the ids of all old or completed livestreams.

Returns:
    List[str] | None: The ids of all old or completed streams or None.

last_streamed.docstring:
Fetches the id of the last completed livestream.

Returns:
    str | None: The id of the last livestreamed video or None.

last_uploaded.docstring:
Fetches the id of the last uploaded video.

Returns:
    Dict[str, Any] | None: The id of the last uploaded video or None.

upcoming.docstring:
Fetches the upcoming scheduled videos.

Returns:
    List[str] | None: The ids of upcoming scheduled videos or None.

shorts.docstring:
Fetches uploaded shorts and their basic metadata.

Returns:
    Dict[str, Any] | None: A dict containing basic metadata of uploaded shorts or None.

videos.docstring:
Fetches upto 30 uploaded videos and their basic metadata.

Returns:
    Dict[str, Any] | None: A dict containing basic metadata of uploaded videos or None.

playlists.docstring:
Fetches the basic metadata of some public playlists.

Returns:
    List[Dict[str, Any]] | None: The basic metadata of all playlists or None.

RequestError.name: RequestError
RequestError.docstring: When an error occurs while making a request.

TooManyRequests.name: TooManyRequests
TooManyRequests.docstring: When too many requests are made to the YouTube API in a short period of time.

metadata.docstring:
Fetches playlist metadata in a dict format

Returns
-------
Dict
    Playlist metadata in a dict format containing keys: id, url, name, video_count, thumbnail,

Short.name: Short
Short.docstring: Represents a YouTube Short video and provides methods to extract its metadata.

author.docstring:
Returns the author of the short video.

Returns:
    Dict[str, str]: Author of the short video.

title.docstring:
Returns the title of the short video.

Returns:
    str: Title of the short video.

description.docstring:
Returns the description of the short video.

Returns:
    str: Description of the short video.

thumbnail.docstring:
Returns the thumbnail of the short video.

Returns:
    str: Thumbnail url of the short video.

date.docstring:
Returns the date of publishing of the short video.

Returns:
    str: Date of publishing of the short video.

regions_allowed.docstring:
Returns the regions allowed for the short video.

Returns:
    List[str]: List of regions allowed for the short video.

genre.docstring:
Returns the genre of the short video.

Returns:
    str: Genre of the short video.

views.docstring:
Returns the view count of the short video.

Returns:
    int: View count of the short video.

likes.docstring:
Returns the likes count of the short video.

Returns:
    str: Likes count of the short video.

dup_filter.name: dup_filter
dup_filter.signature: (iterable: list, limit: int | None = None) -> List[Any]
dup_filter.docstring:
Utility function for filtering out duplicate items.

Args:
    iterable (list): The list of items to filter.
    limit (Optional[int]): The maximum number of items to return.

extract_initial_data.name: extract_initial_data
extract_initial_data.docstring:
Utility function for extracting the initial data from the HTML of a YouTube page.

Args:
    html (str): The HTML of the YouTube page.

request.name: request
request.docstring:
The base function for making a request with proper headers.

Args:
    url (str): The url to make a request.

url.docstring:
Returns the url of the video.

Returns:
    str: Url of the video.

title.docstring:
Returns the title of the video.

Returns:
    str: Title of the video.

description.docstring:
Returns the description of the video.

Returns:
    str: Description of the video.

thumbnail.docstring:
Returns the thumbnail of the video.

Returns:
    str: Thumbnail of the video.

views.docstring:
Returns the view count of the video.

Returns:
    str: View count of the video.

published.docstring:
Returns the date of publication of the video.

Returns:
    str: Date of publication of the video.

likes.docstring:
Returns the likes count of the video.

Returns:
    str | None: Likes count of the video.

owner.docstring:
Returns the details such as, id, title, avatars, subscribers of the owner of the video.

Returns:
    Dict[str, Any]: Details of the owner.

duration_ms.docstring:
Returns the approximate duration of the video in milliseconds.

Returns:
    int: Duration of the video.

genre.docstring:
Returns the genre of the video.

Returns:
    str | None: Genre of the video.

keywords.docstring:
Returns the keywords of the video.

Returns:
    List[str] | None: Keywords of the video.

livestream.docstring:
Returns whether the video is a livestream or not.

Returns:
    bool: True if the video is a livestream, False otherwise.

watermark.docstring:
Returns the watermark image url of the video.

Returns:
    str | None: Watermark of the video.
